title: Delivery by the clocked machine
statement: Let $e:\\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}\\hookrightarrow\Gamma$ be an embedding, let $M$ be a machine with $k$ work tapes over $\Gamma$ and state set $S$, and let $\mathrm{stopAt}:S\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$. Fix an input word $x$, a configuration $c$ of $M$, a state $q\in S$, Boolean words $w,w'$, a tape content $ct:\mathbb Z\to\mathrm{Option}(\Gamma)$, an integer head position $cp$, and natural numbers $\tau,B,T$. Suppose $w'$ and $w$ have the same length, $T\le B$, the state obtained by applying $\mathrm{exit}$ to the state of $M$ after $\tau$ steps belongs to the finish-or-timeout exit set, and the clocked machine started from the configuration with state $\mathrm{dec}(q,\mathrm{run})$, underlying configuration $c$, and clock tape $(ct,cp)$ reaches after $T$ steps the configuration with state $\mathrm{exit}$ applied to the state of $M$ after $\tau$ steps, underlying configuration $M$ after $\tau$ steps, and clock tape obtained by patching $ct$ at $cp$ with the encoded word $e(w')$. Assume this run avoids finish and timeout states before time $T$, its clock head remains between $cp-1$ and $cp+|w|$ through time $T$, and at every time $u\le T$ its original work-tape contents and head positions, input-head position, and output agree with those of $M$ at some time $v\le\tau$. Then there are a time $T'\le B$ and a Boolean word $w''$ of length $|w|$ such that the clocked machine reaches the corresponding configuration patched with $e(w'')$ at time $T'$, avoids finish and timeout states at every earlier time, and at each time $u\le T'$ its original work tapes, input position, and output agree with those of $M$ at some time $v\le\tau$, while its clock head remains between $cp-1$ and $cp+|w|$.
